proposed_fixes.title: Reapply FancyZones placement after custom-chrome startup settles
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The saved-zone restore runs before some custom-chrome applications finalize their non-client bounds; the application then adjusts its frame and leaves a gap at screen edges.
plan: Trace the last-known-zone restore path around SizeWindowToRect and window-creation events.
Replace an arbitrary delay with a bounded follow-up placement triggered after the target window reaches stable bounds.
Limit the retry to restored windows whose actual rectangle diverges from the target zone, avoiding movement loops.
verification: Restore Visual Studio and Unity windows into edge-touching zones and verify exact bounds at startup without regressions for standard windows.

confidence.rationale: The reporter isolated the timing boundary and confirmed that a delayed SetWindowPlacement removes the gap, but the correct lifecycle signal needs design work.
